description: This file contains classes and methods related to the configuration and handling of Fal AI image generation API interactions within the litellm framework, including URL construction, environment validation, response transformation, and parameter mapping.

classes.name: FalAIBaseConfig
classes.description: Base configuration class for Fal AI image generation models, providing URL construction, environment validation, and response transformation functionalities.

classes.name: FalAIImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Derived class providing specific configuration for Fal AI image generation, including supported parameter mapping and request transformation.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_image_generation_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ImageResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms raw HTTP responses into the standardized ImageResponse format, extracting image data.

methods.name: List[OpenAIImageGenerationOptionalParams] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters for the image generation models.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters into the optional_params dict, validating support for each parameter.

methods.name: dict transform_image_generation_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares the request body for image generation API calls, combining prompt and optional parameters.
